newsitem.title: USA: OrthoLogic Corp to buy Toronto Medical.
newsitem.headline: OrthoLogic Corp to buy Toronto Medical.

text.p: OrthoLogic Corp on Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Toronto Medical Corp, a developer, manufacturer and marketer of continuous passive motion devices.
Financial details of the deal, which is expected to close by about March 15, were not disclosed.

OrthoLogic said in a statement the acquisition of Toronto Medical would complement its existing product line of continuous passive motion devices, recently obtained through the Sutter Corp acquisition.

OrthoLogic said it hoped to establish itself as a one-stop shop for orthopedic rehabilitation products and services, including bone-growth stimulation, continuous passive motion devices, cryotherapy and bracing.
